title: DEATHTOPIA
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After eye surgery following a car accident, teenager Koh Fujimura can sense strange apparitions: killers who look human to everyone else. He joins three female agents (Maya Hoshimiya, Yui Kisagari and Saki Yagami) hunting a serial killer in Tokyo who targets eyeballs (Kodansha blurb via AniList/MU; Manga Critic review).
life_message: An ordinary person with a rare gift is pulled into fighting hidden predators; courage means using that gift for others despite fear.

folkways.japan: A seinen thriller from Kodansha's Evening magazine, where fan service and gore are genre conventions aimed at adult readers.

delivery.evidence: Manga Critic describes plot-light action and cheesecake, no message speeches (to verify).
delivery.note: The killers appear as monsters rather than holders of a view, so no worldview is argued.

winners_losers: Koh and the agents are positioned as protectors; the killers are inhuman threats with no sympathy.
